change_reason: V2.8 forward reviews showed two complementary risks: forced Fusion slots can displace a strong Evidence ticket, while a strong Scarcity complete combination can deserve protection. V2.9 therefore restores the full V2.7 5/3/2 portfolio as the baseline and makes Fusion replacement conditional rather than mandatory.

protected_core.rule: Protect the highest combined-score selected ticket from each of Evidence, Scarcity and Neutral before considering Fusion replacement.
